title: Mass and Schwarzschild radius
hook: Change mass and predict Schwarzschild radius.
misconception: Schwarzschild radius stays fixed when mass doubles.
objective: Apply r_s = 2GM/c² to compare Schwarzschild radius when mass changes, under the stated assumptions.

claims.text: With a nonrotating uncharged Schwarzschild solution, r_s = 2GM/c². When mass doubles, Schwarzschild radius becomes 2 times its original value.
claims.source: Idealized model r_s = 2GM/c²; scaling exponent 1. Physics and assumptions await independent review.

recall.question: Consider a nonrotating uncharged Schwarzschild solution, with a nonzero initial result. If mass triples from a positive value, what is the multiplier on Schwarzschild radius?
recall.why: Apply r_s = 2GM/c² under the same assumptions: the multiplier is 3.
